title: The northern neighbour: the Monroe Doctrine and the Big Stick
goal: I can explain the Monroe Doctrine and the Big Stick policy, reporting what the presidents declared.

items: I can say what Monroe declared in 1823.
I can say what Roosevelt said the United States could do.
I can report what someone said with *dijo que* and *declaró que*.
I can report what a president declared, moving the tense back.
I can say what Monroe declared in 1823.
I can say what the policy of the Big Stick was.
I can say what Mexico lost in 1848.
I can say what historians say about the Monroe Doctrine.
